name: success judged while upkeep continues
what_it_changes: Within F17, the room judges success by recognizable survival rather than a perfect mark, treats completion as a milestone, and keeps the obligation to maintain.
why: Cut rule R3: a level-3 child of F17's key, held by 5 or more of its members, whose lines (read in _analysis/d4a02_keys/add-step_P11_T4-026.txt) state a narrower change than F17's. 'Participants assess success through recognizable survival rather than perfect lettering, while maintenance continues after celebration' (bostonceltics); 'Celebration can mark a temporary accomplishment while members explicitly retain the obligation to maintain it' (ripcity). These are the labelers' how sentences.
